title: After the Satsuki Sho: First, We Eat

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser wins the Satsuki Sho in magnificent fashion and turns her attention to the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Disappointed by their losses, Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower both vow to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of them continue onward, aiming for victory at the Japanese Derby.
